title: How a Rusty Engine Is Restored

research.note: Storyboard only. Do not claim the depicted restoration is real until the actual sequence is checked against footage and the relevant engine's service manual.

voiceover: Watch this rusty engine come back to life. First, we record every connection and check for damage. With the power disconnected, the engine comes apart piece by piece. Grease is removed and the rusty outer surfaces are cleaned, keeping abrasive tools away from precision parts. Worn seals and damaged components are replaced with compatible parts. Everything goes back in the right order, with bolts tightened to the specified torque. Fresh oil goes in before the first start. Finally, we check for leaks and listen to the engine run. Like and subscribe for more restorations.
